dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh, so there's a Melusine newspaper nowadays?

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: I—I'm working on one of my own. I record the things that happen every day into it — and I make some drawings for it, too.

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: Huh. Wait a moment, I'm the one conducting the interview, so why are you the one asking the questions? Well, whatever — as long as the content's newsworthy...

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: Hmm... "Outland Visitor Reports Business to Merusea Chief Reporter! Guest Interested in the Future of Melusine News Industry!"
